review: Set-SecurityState refuses lowering the highest valid floor, publishes and verifies a flushed new backup pair before replacing primary, and preserves a valid committed recovery copy when the primary pair is incomplete.
faults_exercised: Exception injected immediately after actual new bak2 pair verification, before primary publication; Get-SecurityState recovers the new floor.
Real file-sharing lock prevents primary checksum File.Replace after primary data replacement; incomplete primary pair is observed, then new bak2 restores exact bytes and valid checksum.
Subsequent lower-version write refuses without changing protected files; temporary pending artifacts are cleaned.
compatibility: Actual Windows PowerShell 5 execution covers File.Replace with NullString and flush/readback behavior. Inline AST-extracted functions avoid file execution-policy changes and never execute HostAgent top-level code.
scope: Only tests edited by this reviewer; source reviewed read-only. All operations use temporary directories and generated state.
limits: No real power-cut or filesystem-wide durability guarantee was tested.
Simultaneous corruption of all valid copies is fail-closed rather than recoverable.
These checks do not establish installed activation, enrollment recovery or physical eject/reinsert acceptance.
